description: Component to control the app's status bar. Displays current time, network info, battery, and other status icons. Supports multiple mounted instances and a stack-based imperative API.

currentHeight.description: Height of the status bar including notch if present.

animated.description: Animate transitions between status bar property changes.

backgroundColor.description: Background color of the status bar. Deprecated in Android 15+.
backgroundColor.default: system default or black if undefined

barStyle.description: Color of the status bar text. On Android, affects API 23+.

hidden.description: Whether the status bar is hidden.

networkActivityIndicatorVisible.description: Shows or hides the network activity indicator.

showHideTransition.description: Transition effect when showing or hiding the status bar.

translucent.description: Makes the status bar translucent. Deprecated in Android 15+.

popStackEntry.description: Get and remove the last StatusBar entry from the stack.

pushStackEntry.description: Push a StatusBar entry onto the stack.

replaceStackEntry.description: Replace an existing StatusBar stack entry with new props.

setBackgroundColor.description: Set the status bar background color. Deprecated in Android 15+.

setBarStyle.description: Set the status bar text/icon style.

setHidden.description: Show or hide the status bar.

setNetworkActivityIndicatorVisible.description: Control visibility of network activity indicator.

setTranslucent.description: Control translucency of the status bar. Deprecated in Android 15+.

StatusBarAnimation.description: iOS animation type when showing/hiding the status bar.

StatusBarStyle.description: Text and icon color style of the status bar.
